recipes.name: Quiet four-pose cycle
recipes.description: Low amplitude ambient cycle; frame zero is a readable calm static pose.
recipes.loop_seam: Last pose approaches first without a jump.

recipes.name: Four-beat expression
recipes.description: Readable anticipation, expression apex and recovery for a discrete response.
recipes.loop_seam: One-shot ends in recoverable posture; completion selects a state rather than interpolating.

recipes.name: Four-beat sustained task
recipes.description: Deliberate repeated task attention with alternating inspection and execution.
recipes.loop_seam: Reset preserves task focus and planted scale.

recipes.name: Four-contact locomotion
recipes.description: Alternating contacts or body undulation conveying travel at a shared viewport scale.
recipes.loop_seam: Opposite contact returns smoothly to first stride; position stays within assigned cell.

recipes.name: Impact and recovery
recipes.description: Brief anticipation, fast impulse, visible response and gentle stabilization.
recipes.loop_seam: One-shot; finish visibly stable before recovery transition.

recipes.name: Slow posture change
recipes.description: Unhurried whole-body transition into a resting or held pose.
recipes.loop_seam: One-shot destination held or completed to the requested resting state.

recipes.name: Brief expression accent
recipes.description: Short local movement with a clear apex and a return near its entry pose.
recipes.loop_seam: One-shot; return near entry avoids abrupt changes when selecting idle.

recipes.name: Static expressive pose
recipes.description: A single intentionally static pose, not duplicated pseudo-animation.

recipes.name: Two separated blinks
recipes.description: Five exact eyelid states distinguish two separate blink closures without asking one frame to represent several poses.
recipes.loop_seam: One-shot starts and ends with the same resting open-eye expression.
